text:
Alex W.: Quick sync — we need final owners + any blockers for event schema v2 and the token-cost labels. Target milestone: end of week.
Marta D.: I can own the token->cost mapping, but I'm blocked until eng-runtime emits an exec latency histogram tag (we need more granular timing than p95).
Raj P.: Runtime side: fine to add. Proposal is a new optional field `exec_latency_ms`. ETA Wed (depends on a small kernel tweak).
Sasha L.: @Raj P. can we ensure this is backward compatible? lots of downstream jobs expect the old shape.
Raj P.: Plan is non-breaking — add `exec_latency_ms` while keeping current fields. Ingest will fallback to p50/p95 if absent.
Tyler (data-eng): Pipeline side: we'll accept `exec_latency_ms` in event.v2 and keep the tokens->cost join intact. Need a sample event payload to validate.
Alex W.: Attaching a sample event payload — use for smoke tests:
```json
{
  "event_type": "inference_request",
  "model": "gpt-redwood-13b",
  "tokens": 143,
  "exec_latency_ms": 122.4,
  "token_cost_cents": 0.37,
  "env": "prod-canary"
}
```
Marta D.: FYI the cost library will rename `token_count` -> `tokens` in next minor. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/costlib/pull/42 — might affect a few old pipelines.
Sasha L.: Can we add a short migration shim in ingest so we don't have a drop window?
Raj P.: I'll land a runtime shim that copies `token_count` -> `tokens` if present. Target Tue EOD.
Alex W.: Owners summary: Marta = token mapping & costlib, Raj = runtime shim + schema change, Tyler = pipeline ingest & smoke tests, Sasha = rollout plan & QA. Swap if needed?
Tyler (data-eng): +1. I'll open the smoke PR and assign review to @Marta D.
ci-bot: Build passed for branch feat/instr-257 — https://ci.redwood/1234 :white_check_mark:
Alex W.: Canary plan: 30m at 10% traffic, then 1h at 50% if no regressions. @Sasha L. okay to run that?
Sasha L.: Yep. I'll schedule the canary and post the exact steps into #eng-oncall.
Marta D.: One more item — we should standardize latency buckets for cost-per-ms histograms. I'll propose a boundary list in the ticket.
Alex W.: Perfect. I've linked owners in JIRA RD-1252 and will mark this thread for closure after PRs are merged. Thanks everyone :rocket:
